individualTimeline: Episode 9: Daniel first appears when the main roster is privately confirmed and he is named captain.
Episode 65: Aphromoo mentors Moss toward concise, executable leadership during practice against Academy Blue and Academy White.
Episode 75: Moss remains captain and receives responsibility for helping the main roster find its competitive identity when the initial plan fails.
Episode 116 (2027-01-28): Works off-comfort champions chosen from 2027 preparation trends with the League staff.
Episode 118 (2027-01-29): Plays five full private scrims on five champions outside the usual pool against an independent team; the results are practice only.
Episode 123 (2027-02-02): Aphromoo tells him he will stop being his individual mentor; Xpecial becomes his support mentor.
Episode 127 (2027-02-06): Calls a wait for Noah in game 3 vs NRG; Main win 2-1.
